allowedActiveChanges.reason: User-approved declarative-first change for one non-playing GM plus two tactical players: durable command journaling and publication, role-safe live/replay/export projection, reconnect cursors, outcome receipts, append-only correction and rewind, campaign retroactive rebuild, and a strict 80-scenario three-context acceptance program. allowedActiveChanges.name: add-cross-stream-effect-receipts

allowedActiveChanges.name: add-authoritative-history-branches
